rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes adding W to TiVNbTa to form TiVNbTaW, whereas the paper compared CrFeTaVW with Ta-substituted-by-Ti CrFeTiVW. These are different alloy systems and different compositional modifications.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis specifies testing at 1273 K under mechanical loading, while the paper used simulations from 300–2100 K, SPS consolidation at 1543–1573 K, and thermal diffusivity measurements from 300–1000 K. The regimes are entirely different.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes solid-solution strengthening and phase stabilization by W addition, whereas the paper's mechanism involves hybrid MC-driven segregation, Laves-phase formation from Fe–Ta mixing enthalpy, and phonon mean-free-path effects on thermal diffusivity. These are unrelated mechanism classes.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts improved high-temperature yield strength, while the paper measured thermal diffusivity and phase constitution. The predicted property and direction are completely different.
